pulses.name: Hydra Saiga: Covert Espionage and Infiltration of Critical Utilities
pulses.description: Hydra Saiga, a suspected Kazakhstani state-sponsored threat actor, has been actively targeting government, energy, and critical infrastructure in Central Asia, Europe, and the Middle East since 2021. The group is known for using Telegram Bot API for C2 communication and employing a mix of custom implants and 'Living off the Land' techniques. pulses.name: New backdoor targeting Ukrainian entities with possible links to Laundry Bear
pulses.description: A new campaign targeting Ukrainian entities has been identified, attributed to actors linked to Russia. The campaign uses judicial and charity-themed lures to deploy a JavaScript-based backdoor called DRILLAPP, which runs through the Edge browser. pulses.name: A Slopoly start to AI-enhanced ransomware attacks
pulses.description: IBM X-Force discovered a likely AI-generated malware named 'Slopoly' used in a ransomware attack by the Hive0163 group. This marks the beginning of AI adoption among cybercrime groups, potentially transforming the threat landscape.
